_meta.unit: victimizations per 1,000 persons age 12 or older
_meta.source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, National Crime Victimization Survey
_meta.name: Violent victimization (NCVS)
_meta.note: Rate of violent victimization (rape/sexual assault, robbery, aggravated assault, simple assault) from the BJS National Crime Victimization Survey, a self-report survey of a nationally representative household sample; does not require the crime to have been reported to police. 2006 NCVS estimates are not comparable to other years (BJS data-collection change); 2016 sample redesign and a 2017 methodology change; 2024 used a split-sample design testing new methods. Self-report survey, not police-reported. Actual source: cv24at01.csv, Appendix table 1 estimates for Figure 1. 2006 is -- and omitted.
_meta.breaks: 2006 NCVS estimates are not comparable to other years (BJS data-collection change); 2016 sample redesign and a 2017 methodology change; 2024 used a split-sample design testing new methods. Self-report survey, not police-reported.
